page.name: Pacing at the provider’s real limit
page.h1: Pacing at the limit your provider actually applies
page.metaTitle: Message pacing at your provider’s real limit
page.metaDescription: A single application quota hides the constraint that blocks you. Pacing is applied per sender number, at the limit your provider actually enforces.
page.lede: The limit that stops your traffic is not your application’s quota — it is the rate your provider applies per sender number. One number, one limit, and a batch that ignores it fails partway through.

sections.h: Why one quota is the wrong number
p: A platform-wide “messages per second” setting tells you nothing about whether a specific number can absorb a batch. Because the provider’s limit is attached to the number, pacing is configured and applied at that same granularity — add a number, and you genuinely add throughput.
bullets: Rate limits shown per connected sender number
Pacing applied per number rather than across the account as a whole
Additional numbers raise the ceiling instead of splitting the same allowance

sections.h: Batches drain predictably instead of failing
p: When a batch exceeds what a number can absorb, the platform paces it out rather than sending into the wall. That turns a partial failure into a longer send, which is a trade you can plan for — and the pace is visible in the logs while it runs.

sections.h: Pacing that matches the real per-number limit
p: Pacing at the per-number limit ships on the SMS channel, where the provider applies its rate to the sender number itself. Email and WhatsApp carry their own limits, handled by those channels rather than through this pipeline.

faq.q: Can I send faster by raising my plan?
faq.a: Throughput here is set by your provider’s limit per number, not by a platform plan ceiling. Adding sender numbers or accounts is what raises it.

faq.q: What happens to a message that cannot be sent within the window?
faq.a: Pacing spreads the batch; it does not silently drop messages. How long a large batch takes depends on the limit attached to the numbers carrying it.

faq.q: Do you pace email the same way?
faq.a: Per-number pacing ships on the SMS channel. Email and WhatsApp limits are separate and are managed by those channels.
